verdict.rationale: Jira can be driven headlessly through its APIs: the vendor claims 'Rich APIs', and community users describe running REST queries and writing API wrapper scripts to file bugs without the slow UI. An official MCP server also allows non-UI agent access, and built-in automation rules connect tools to workflows. However, nothing in the pack shows an official CLI or documented CI usage, and the API docs are thin marketing mentions; probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the tested paths. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI integration or examples, detailed API reference or machine-readable spec.
